Click or tab into any question and its explanation appears here.", next: "A reviewer reads every application, usually within one working day.", link: { label: "How verification works", href: "#" }, }, "legal-name": { title: "Why we need the registered name", body: "The commercial register and your bank both know the business by its legal name, which can differ from the name on your shop. We match the two before any payout.", example: "Halcyon Bike Fitting B.V.", next: "We check it against the register within a minute. A close match is accepted without a person looking at it.", link: { label: "Where to find your registered name", href: "#" }, }, country: { title: "Why the country matters", body: "The country decides which documents we can accept and which tax forms apply. It cannot be changed later without a new application.", next: "The documents you can upload in the next step are limited to what that country accepts.", }, registration: { title: "Your chamber of commerce number", body: "A short number from the commercial register that identifies the business, and nothing else.", example: "81234567", next: "We look it up in the register ourselves, so you do not need to upload an extract.", link: { label: "Find your number in the register", href: "#" }, }, vat: { title: "Your VAT number", body: "We need it to invoice you correctly and to know whether VAT is due on our fees. Not VAT-registered yet? Leave it empty and tell us in the next step.", example: "NL123456789B01", next: "We validate the number with the European VIES service.", }, revenue: { title: "Why we ask about revenue", body: "An estimate is enough. It sets your first payout limit, which grows by itself as you sell.", next: "You can change the estimate later in Settings.", }, director: { title: "Who counts as the director", body: "The person who can legally sign for the business: a director, a managing partner, or the owner of a sole proprietorship. We ask them to confirm their identity in the next step.", example: "Imani Okafor", }, }; const OWNER_HELP: Record = { name: { title: "Your name as on your passport", body: "We compare it with your ID document in the next step, so use the full name rather than a nickname.", example: "Imani Okafor", next: "It appears on invoices and on the account owner line in your settings.", }, email: { title: "Why a work address is best", body: "Security alerts and payout notices go here. A shared inbox such as billing@ is fine, as long as someone reads it.", example: "imani@halcyonbikes.example", next: "We send a code to this address to confirm it is yours.", }, phone: { title: "When we would call you", body: "Only to confirm a large or unusual payout, never to sell you anything.
